module purpose: The module implements a default on-chip debugger authenticator: it stores a 1-bit authentication-valid state, clears it on reset or when disabled, captures wdata_i(0) on a qualified write, and drives the stored state on valid_o. busy_o and rdata_o are hardwired to '0', and re_i is unused.

use-case flows.value: authentication-valid bit loaded from wdata_i(0) when enable_i = '1' and we_i = '1'
stored authentication-valid bit driven on valid_o
authentication-valid bit forced to '0' when rstn_i = '0' or when enable_i = '0' on a rising clock edge
